def is_safe_log_message(message: str) -> bool:
    # Simple check for potentially harmful content
    return not any(char in message for char in ['<', '>', '&', '"', "'"])

# Test the function
assert is_safe_log_message("This is a safe log message") == True
assert is_safe_log_message("This is a <malicious> log message") == False
